question_cn: D 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group D?
one_liner_cn: Elo 全组最高的土耳其约五成概率拿下 D 组头名；东道主美国虽有主场加成，但 Cardoso、Agyemang 伤缺令其与巴拉圭的第二名之争更胶着。
one_liner_en: Türkiye, holding the group's highest Elo, has roughly a 50% chance of topping Group D; hosts USA enjoy home advantage but the injury absences of Cardoso and Agyemang tighten their race with Paraguay for second.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其 Elo 1911（世界第 13）为全组最高，比第二高的巴拉圭（1834）高 77 分，比澳大利亚（1777）和美国（1726）优势更大；纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛基线即给出 49.2% 的头名概率。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's Elo of 1911 (world #13) is the group's highest — 77 points above second-ranked Paraguay (1834) and further clear of Australia (1777) and USA (1726); the pure-Elo Monte Carlo baseline alone gives them a 49.2% group-winner probability.

key_reasons.cn: 美国三场小组赛全部在本土（模型已含小组赛 +100 Elo 主场加成），但主力后腰 Johnny Cardoso 与前锋 Patrick Agyemang 因伤无缘世界杯，故对美国基线下调 2 个百分点。
key_reasons.en: USA play all three group games at home (the model already includes a +100 Elo host bonus in group play), but starting midfielder Johnny Cardoso and forward Patrick Agyemang miss the tournament through injury, so the USA baseline is shaded down by 2pp.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其 6 月 2 日公布的 26 人名单以 Güler、Yıldız 为核心且无重大伤病消息，阵容完整度支持其维持模型基线。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's 26-man squad announced on June 2, built around Güler and Yıldız, carries no major injury news — full squad availability supports keeping them at the model baseline.

method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo, 100,000 full-tournament simulations (seed 20260611), eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 Elo host bonus for USA in group matches only, no market input. Single bounded adjustment: USA -2pp for confirmed injury absences (Cardoso, Agyemang), other teams renormalized proportionally to sum to 1.
